abontenCreditBody: Credit you've earned from rewards. Use it at checkout. It can't be cashed out, and some of it expires.
cancelBodyFullRefund: Your held tickets go back on sale and {refund} comes back to you.
cancelBodyKeepsFee: Your held tickets go back on sale. {refund} comes back to you; the {kept} service fee is not refunded.
cancelBodyNothingPaid: Your held tickets go back on sale. Nothing has been paid, so there is nothing to refund.
couldNotCancel: We couldn't cancel this plan. Please try again.
couldNotSave: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
couldNotStartPayment: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
couldNotStartPlan: We couldn't start your plan. Please try again.
endedAccountClosed: This plan ended because the account was closed.
endedDeadline: This plan wasn't finished by its deadline, so the tickets went back on sale.
endedEventCancelled: The organizer cancelled the event, so this plan has ended.
endedHoldExpired: The hold ended before the first payment, so the tickets went back on sale.
feeKept: The {amount} service fee is not refunded.
finishBy: {left} left to pay. Finish by {deadline} ({days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}).
holdUntil: Your tickets are held until {time}. Make your first payment to keep them until {deadline}.
howDoYouWantToPay: How do you want to pay?
issuingTickets: Fully paid! We're issuing your tickets…
networkError: Couldn't reach Abonten. Check your connection and try again.
noOpenPlans: You're not paying small small for anything right now.
noOpenPlansHowTo: On an event that offers it, choose Pay small small at checkout to lock the price and pay in parts.
noOpenPlansUnavailable: Pay small small isn't available to you yet.
organizerCardBody: Let buyers lock the price and pay for their tickets in parts before the event. Their tickets are held until they finish, and you're paid for each ticket once its plan is fully paid.
organizerStats: {open, plural, one {# plan running} other {# plans running}}, {held, plural, one {# ticket held} other {# tickets held}}, {done, plural, one {# fully paid} other {# fully paid}}.
organizerUnavailable: Not available to your account yet.
partRefundProblem: Refund delayed. Our team is on it.
payInFullLine: Pay the whole price now and get your tickets straight away.
paySmallSmallLine: Lock this price, hold your tickets and pay in parts. Finish by {deadline}.
paymentStillConfirming: Your payment is still being confirmed.
pendingPayment: A payment is waiting to be approved. Approve it on your phone, then check.
refundOnItsWay: Your refund of {amount} is on its way.
refundProblem: Part of your refund is delayed. Our team is looking into it.
savedTowardsTicketsBody: Money you've paid on plans that are still running. It goes to your tickets when a plan is finished, or comes back to you if it ends.
termFirstPart: First payment: at least {amount} ({pct} of the total).
termFirstPartShare: First payment: at least {pct} of the total.
termHold: Your tickets are held for {minutes} minutes while you make the first payment.
termLaterParts: After that, pay any amount of at least {pct} of the total, whenever you like. The last payment can be whatever is left.
termMaxTickets: {count, plural, one {You can pay small small for # ticket at a time.} other {You can pay small small for up to # tickets at a time.}}
termNotFinishedFullRefund: Not finished by {deadline}? Your tickets go back on sale and all your money comes back to you.
termNotFinishedKeepsFee: Not finished by {deadline}? Your tickets go back on sale and your money comes back to you, minus the service fee.
termTicketsWhenPaid: Your tickets are issued as soon as everything is paid.
ticketsReadyBody: You've paid in full. Your tickets are in My Tickets, and we've emailed them to you.
youReAlreadyPayingForThisEvent: You're already paying small small for this event.
